commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+6' After what seems an eternity, referee Peter Bankes decides NO GOAL for Nottingham after the VAR review! Play to continue.
90+4' Nottingham score a goal, but referee Peter Bankes has now indicated he wants to check if the goal can stand using VAR!
90+3' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Ryan Yates (Nottingham) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
90+3' Nottingham can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90+2' Jota Silva (Nottingham) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. Nottingham force a corner. They send men into the box.
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
89' Here comes a substitution. Ramon Sosa (Nottingham) is brought on as a substitute for Callum Hudson-Odoi.
89' Nuno Espirito Santo prepares a substitution. Ola Aina is replaced by Eric da Silva Moreira (Nottingham).
87' Great chance! Nikola Milenkovic (Nottingham) collects a great pass inside the box, but the goalkeeper does well to stop his effort. Nottingham win a corner.
87' Nottingham take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
86' Nottingham take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
83' Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham) slips past a defender on the edge of the box and hits a shot at goal that rises just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.
81' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Peter Bankes ignores the protests.
81' Alex Moreno (Nottingham) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Lukasz Fabianski intercepts the ball.
79' Chris Wood comes off the pitch to be replaced by Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham).
79' Substitution. Emerson did his best and is replaced by Andrew Irving (West Ham).

78' 3 - 0 Goal! Ola Aina (Nottingham) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the top left corner. Lukasz Fabianski had no chance of reaching it. The score is 3:0.
77' Peter Bankes shows a yellow card to Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) for a tough tackle.
74' Nikola Milenkovic (Nottingham) misses a complete sitter from the corner, heading the ball well wide of the left post from close in. The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.
74' The linesman makes the right call and Nottingham will have a corner.
73' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
70' Great touch by Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) as he receives a precise pass deep inside the box and rips a shot goalwards, but the keeper pulls off an amazing save!
70' Alex Moreno (Nottingham) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.

68' Good chance! Alex Moreno (Nottingham) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored! The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.
67' Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
65' 2 - 0 A cross from the free kick is whipped deep into the box by Elliot Anderson and Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) gets in a shot, sending the ball inside the right post. 2:0.
64' Jean-Clair Todibo (West Ham) makes a slide tackle, but referee Peter Bankes blows for a foul. Nottingham are awarded a free kick.
63' Nuno Espirito Santo has decided to make a change. Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) replaces Morgan Gibbs-White.
63' Here comes a substitution. Anthony Elanga is given a rest as he is replaced by Jota Silva (Nottingham).
62' A pass from Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) is intercepted by Lukasz Fabianski and the move breaks down.
61' The resulting set piece from Nottingham is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

60' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Nottingham.
59' The corner from Carlos Soler (West Ham) is intercepted by the defence.
58' Aaron Wan-Bissaka (West Ham) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. West Ham have a corner.
58' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
57' Murillo (Nottingham) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
56' Nottingham have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
56' Ola Aina (Nottingham) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. The ball goes out of play. Nottingham are awarded a corner kick.
56' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
55' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked. Corner kick. Nottingham will have an opportunity.

54' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and shoots towards goal, but it goes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for West Ham.
53' Carlos Soler (West Ham) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
53' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play. West Ham are awarded a corner kick.
52' Ola Aina (Nottingham) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
48' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) pounced on a rebound on the edge of the box and his shot goes a whisker over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Nottingham will have a goal kick.
48' The linesman points to the corner flag, West Ham are going to take it.

48' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) makes a good run into the box to meet a cross and fires the ball in on goal, but the shot is amazingly blocked by a defender. The referee points to the corner flag and West Ham will take a corner.
47' An attempted cross from Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) is cleared.
46' Half-time substitution. Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) will not participate anymore and Michail Antonio is coming on.
46' The game is over for Guido Rodriguez (West Ham). Carlos Soler comes on for the second half.
46' The whistle blows and Peter Bankes starts the second half.
45+5' The first half of today's match has just finished.

45+5' Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for West Ham.
45+4' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
45+2' West Ham failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

45+2' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) collects a rebound and his promising attempt heads towards the bottom left corner, but Matz Sels keeps it out with an amazing save. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to West Ham.
45+2' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
45+2' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
45+2' Peter Bankes blows his whistle and Edson Alvarez (West Ham) is shown a second yellow card for his foul. His manager will not be pleased. He has lot of time to think about it as he walks off.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.

42' Nikola Milenkovic (Nottingham) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Peter Bankes blows his whistle for an infringement. It's a free kick to West Ham, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
42' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Anthony Elanga (Nottingham). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

42' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. Nottingham have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
41' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
39' A yellow card for a tackle by Edson Alvarez (West Ham). Peter Bankes doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
39' Max Kilman (West Ham) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
38' Max Kilman (West Ham) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

37' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) is first to latch onto the rebound inside the penalty area. He sends a promising shot towards the middle of the goal, but it is denied by the goalkeeper who pulls off a superb save.

36' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
32' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Peter Bankes blows for a foul. A free kick to West Ham.
32' Guido Rodriguez (West Ham) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.

31' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Peter Bankes signals. It's a free kick to West Ham, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
30' Ola Aina (Nottingham) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
27' 1 - 0 Goal! Alex Moreno picks out Chris Wood (Nottingham) in the box with a decent cross, and he scores low in the middle of the goal with a header from close range. 1:0.

25' Excellent touch by Chris Wood (Nottingham)! He latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box and produces a shot goalwards which goes way wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.
25' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Aaron Wan-Bissaka (West Ham) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
24' Ola Aina (Nottingham) plays a through ball which would have led to a great opportunity, if it hadn't been stopped by the defence.
21' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) commits a rough challenge and Peter Bankes blows his whistle for an infringement. West Ham are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
20' Two players stand over the free kick. Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) eventually steps forward, but his attempt from the edge of the box is blocked by the defensive wall.
18' Peter Bankes shows a yellow card to Guido Rodriguez (West Ham), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
17' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
17' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
16' Aaron Wan-Bissaka (West Ham) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball goes out for a corner. West Ham can continue in their attacking effort.
14' Emerson (West Ham) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
14' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.
11' Alex Moreno (Nottingham) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Peter Bankes blows for a foul. A free kick is awarded to West Ham.

10' Good team movement sets up Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) on the edge of the box, but he slices the ball narrowly wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for West Ham.
10' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
9' Edson Alvarez (West Ham) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
8' Edson Alvarez (West Ham) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Peter Bankes no option but to blow his whistle. Nottingham win a free kick.
8' Max Kilman (West Ham) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.
6' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.
5' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
4' The goal by Nottingham won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
4' That looked like an offside in the build-up play and the referee Peter Bankes is going to take a look using VAR.

3' Close! Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for West Ham.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Nottingham will have the kick-off.
Peter Bankes will officiate today.
Show lineups Both teams starting lineups are available now, so you can have a look at them.
